verdict.rationale: The evidence pack confirms n8n has a documented REST API (n8n-docs-16) and a CLI (n8n-docs-17), but there's no evidence establishing that this API achieves full feature parity with the UI (e.g., building/editing every workflow node type, credentials, AI agent config, etc.), and a probe for a discoverable OpenAPI spec at standard paths returned 404s. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or independent testing confirming API/UI parity, a published OpenAPI spec, and evidence AI-native users can fully replicate complex canvas actions (agent config, node wiring) purely via API.
